name: The three states and the fourth (waking, dream, deep sleep, turīya)

definitions.definition: The self has four quarters: vaiśvānara (waking, outward-knowing, enjoyer of the gross), taijasa (dream, inward-knowing, enjoyer of the separated), prājña (deep sleep, become one, mass of cognition, enjoyer of bliss) and the fourth, described by negation and as the stilling of the world, auspicious and non-dual.

name: The measures of Oṃ (a, u, m)

definitions.definition: The self as the syllable: a is vaiśvānara, u is taijasa, m is prājña; the fourth is without measure; the quarters are the measures and the measures the quarters.
